answer: Sybil resistance here rests on tax-record anchor across twenty check-ins verified by manual notary countersign. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a kernel for each honest agent, a trellis for the network, and a saffron that marks verified work.
